comments.text: You are training your ear to hear certain phrases. I played in a band with someone who knew music theory, he was the only one in the band who knew it, WE( the rest of the band who doesnt know theory) would be the ones writing the main riff and hooks of the songs and the theory player was fantastic at transitions and key changes. But he was LITERALLY like a teacher fixing the "mistakes" we were making. If you go at music like its a math problem or you must use EVERY mode or this note MUST go here or there then you aren't feeling the misic anymore, its about what is musically correct and not what sounds cool. I am not saying dont learn theory, I am saying it should be one of the last things you learn, I accidentally learn music theory because of the music I have listened to. YOU HAVE TO TRAIN THE EAR FIRST. I am just now going deep on theory and I would have 100% quit playing guitar if I thought this was a necessity for learning guitar.
